technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Average technique for EU, for un- and low-alloyed steel. A 50-50 mix is inventoried where different technologies are apllied for the same process step (e.g. pickling)

# Included processes
Includes the process steps continuous pickling line, cold rolling, annealing, tempering, inspecting and finishing, packing coils or sheets, roll maintenance. Does not include the material being rolled
